title: Probability is at most one
statement: For a circuit $C$ on $n$ Boolean inputs and a probability mass function $\mu$ on Boolean assignments, the probability that $C$ evaluates to true under $\mu$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a probability mass function on Boolean assignments to those inputs
